The proposed answer is incorrect because of a sign error in the root r, which also makes the final value have the wrong sign.

**Setup.** Let g(x) = x²f(x), which has degree 9. Then g(k) = 1 at the 8 points k_i = i(i+1), and g(0) = g′(0) = 0. So g(x) − 1 = (ax + b)P(x), where P(x) = ∏(x − k_i).

**Finding a and b.**
- Since there are 8 factors, P(0) = ∏k_i = 8!·9!.
- From g(0) = 0 we get b = −1/P(0).
- From g′(0) = 0 we get aP(0) + bP′(0) = 0, so a = −b·P′(0)/P(0).
- Here P′(0)/P(0) = Σ 1/(0 − k_i) = −Σ 1/(i(i+1)) = −8/9, so a = 8b/9.
- Hence ax + b = b(8x/9 + 1), whose root is x = −9/8. The proposal has r = +9/8, which is wrong.

**Evaluating at 90.**
- At x = 90, ax + b = b(80 + 1) = −81/P(0).
- Since 90 − i(i+1) = (9 − i)(10 + i), P(90) = 8!·(18!/10!).
- So f(90) − 1/90² = (ax + b)P(90)/90² = −81·18!/(10!·9!·8100) = −(1/100)·18!/(10!·9!).
- Using 18!/(9!·9!) = 48620, we get 18!/(10!·9!) = 4862.
- Therefore f(90) − 1/90² = −4862/100 = −2431/50.

The correct answer is −2431/50, which does not match 192049/4050.

VERDICT: REJECT
